channel.title: BuildFlow for Mac
channel.description: Updates to BuildFlow for Mac, newest first.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
**A new look for the notch.**
- **Black and glowing.** The dropdown is black again, with icon tabs beside the camera, your list and Today side by side, and a soft light that runs round the edge as it opens. - **A greeting first, every time.** Press Control + Option (left side): it says good morning, good afternoon or good evening, then opens your day. - **Alerts and countdowns** glow in their own colour, and meetings and jobs count down with a ring. - **Dark is the new default.** Light is still in the gear menu. - **Check for Updates…** is in the gear menu too.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
**BuildFlow's look, in your notch.**
- **The dropdown is a BuildFlow window now**: the same cards, tabs, colours and type (Inter and Inter Tight) as the website. - **Light and Dark.** Choose Light, Dark or Match macOS from the gear in the dropdown, or from the menu-bar icon. - **A greeting each time you open it.** Press Control + Option (left side) and it says good morning, good afternoon or good evening before showing your day. - **Alerts have Open and Later buttons.**
